implementation_notes.comparison: native Mojo wCQ port vs native Mojo Vyukov protocol from Rigtorp suite
implementation_notes.wcq: experimental; two index rings; sequentially consistent C atomic primitives via external_call; patience 16/64, help delay 16
implementation_notes.vyukov: native Mojo atomics; relaxed position CAS, acquire/release cell sequence; separate UInt64 payload; no spinlock/backoff
implementation_notes.capacity: same useful UInt64 capacity, different memory footprint
implementation_notes.participant_ids: pipeline: producer 0, consumer 1 per edge; farm: source 0, consumer i+1; images: source/collector 0 on distinct queues, worker i+1
